newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Downward pressure may take FTSE to 4,835.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Downward pressure may take FTSE to 4,835.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will be under pressure on Monday as downward momentum gathers pace following last Friday's sharp fall, technical analysts said.
Chart support at 4,850 may be tested but further defensive action from investors may take the index to 4,835, they added.

But although investors will now maintain a cautious approach to the market near-term, there remain some encouraging aspects to the market which should prevent a major calamity from occurring, analysts said.
By 0826 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated down 16.5 to 4,860.7.

The main trend for the FTSE -- stretching back over eight months -- is still up and this trend may allow the index to hold within its 10- and 20-day moving averages as the current corrective phase continues, analysts said.
The FTSE's 10-day moving average is currently at 4,845 while its 20 day average is now at 4,764.

Analysts will carefully monitor market turnover today to gauge the extent of today's sell-off because, despite volatile and deteriorating share prices, some investors may use this opportunity to accumulate stock over the next few days.
